title: The Process of Ageing
question: What is one of the most unpleasant discoveries we make about ourselves as we get older?

meanings.meaning: 充满活力的；精力充沛的；强壮的
meanings.usage: 用来描述人、身体或活动充满力量和活力的状态
不可数名词，常用搭配the likelihood of (doing) sth表示某事发生的可能性

meanings.meaning: 易受伤害的；脆弱的；易受攻击的
meanings.usage: 常与介词to搭配，表示易受某类事物的伤害

meanings.meaning: 渐进的；逐步的；稳步发展的
meanings.usage: 用来描述变化是逐步发生、持续推进的

meanings.meaning: 难以察觉的；细微得几乎感觉不到的
meanings.usage: 用来描述变化、差异等非常小，几乎无法被感知到

meanings.meaning: 陡的；陡峭的；（变化）急剧的
meanings.usage: 除了形容坡度大，还可指数量、程度等突然的大幅变化
指生物体随着时间推移机能衰退的过程，也可作形容词表示“老化的”
复数名词，常用搭配odds in favour of表示“……的可能性很大”，odds against表示“……的可能性很小”

meanings.meaning: 实质上的；事实上的；几乎……的
meanings.usage: 用来描述某事物虽然没有名义上的形式，但实际上已经具备对应的性质
常用来形容人的身体强壮健康，也可形容系统、组织等稳固可靠

meanings.meaning: 不证自明的；显而易见的
meanings.usage: 用来描述事实、道理等不需要证明就很明显的
指物品因长期使用而损坏，也可指人的精力被耗尽
指有生命的生物，包括动物、植物、微生物等
物理学科分支，研究热和其他形式能量之间的转换关系

meanings.meaning: 无定论的；有争议的；未决议的
meanings.usage: 常用搭配a moot point表示“有争议的问题，尚无定论的问题”

phrases.usage: 表示“经历某种损失、衰退”，用来描述被动承受某种机能、资源等的减少

examples.en: Many old people undergo a gradual loss of hearing as they get older.
examples.zh: 很多老年人随着年龄增长会逐渐经历听力衰退。

phrases.usage: 此处表示“有利于；支持”，用在描述概率的语境中说明某种结果发生的可能性更大

examples.en: The odds are in favour of the home team winning this match.
examples.zh: 主队赢得这场比赛的可能性很大。

phrases.usage: 固定表达，表示“某事发生的可能性很小”，其中it指代上文提到的可能性较低的情况

examples.en: If you don't prepare for the exam, the chances are against your passing it.
examples.zh: 如果你不备考，通过考试的可能性很小。

phrases.usage: 表示“依照；根据；与……一致”，用来引出遵循的规则、规律、法律等

examples.en: All the activities are held in accordance with the school's regulations.
examples.zh: 所有活动都是依照学校的规定开展的。

phrases.usage: 表示“与……类似；与……相似”，用来比较两个事物有相似的特征或性质

examples.en: The function of a computer's CPU is analogous to the human brain.
examples.zh: 计算机中央处理器的功能和人类大脑类似。

phrases.usage: 表示“相比之下；与此相反”，用于连接两个形成对比的内容，突出二者的差异

examples.en: The north of the country is dry, while the south, by contrast, is very rainy.
examples.zh: 这个国家的北部很干燥，相比之下，南部则多雨。

phrases.usage: 表示“磨损；侵蚀；逐渐消失”，指物体因摩擦、使用等逐步被损耗

examples.en: The inscription on the old stone has worn away over hundreds of years.
examples.zh: 这块古老石头上的铭文经过数百年已经被磨损了。

phrases.usage: 表示“除了……之外都；几乎”，两种常见含义，这里指“除了……之外都”

examples.en: She finished all but the last question on the test paper.
examples.zh: 她做完了试卷上除了最后一题之外的所有题目。

phrases.usage: 表示“使某人不省人事；使某人疲惫不堪；击败某人”，文中指疾病严重到使人失去生命

examples.en: The strong punch knocked the boxer out in the first round.
examples.zh: 重重的一拳在第一回合就把拳击手打晕了。

sentences.en: At the age of twelve years, the human body is at its most vigorous.
sentences.zh: 在十二岁时，人体处于最旺盛的状态。

sentences.en: It has yet to reach its full size and strength, and its owner his or her full intelligence: but at this age the likelihood of death is least.
sentences.zh: 它尚未达到完全的体型和力量，其主人也尚未达到完全的智力：但在此时，死亡的可能性最小。

sentences.en: Earlier, we were infants and young children, and consequently more vulnerable;
sentences.zh: 早些时候，我们是婴儿和幼儿，因此更容易受到伤害；

sentences.en: later, we shall undergo a progressive loss of our vigour and resistance which, though imperceptible at first
sentences.zh: 之后，我们将经历活力和抵抗力的逐渐丧失，这起初虽然难以察觉，

sentences.en: will finally become so steep that we can live no longer,
sentences.zh: 但最终会变得如此迅速，以至于我们无法再活下去，

sentences.en: however well we look after ourselves, and however well society, and our doctors, look after us.
sentences.zh: 无论我们如何精心照顾自己，也无论社会和医生如何精心照顾我们。

sentences.en: This decline in vigour with the passing of time is called ageing.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这种活力的衰退被称为衰老。

sentences.en: It is one of the most unpleasant discoveries which we all make that we must decline in this way, that if we escape wars,
sentences.zh: 我们都发现了一个最令人不快的现实，那就是我们必然会以这种方式衰老，如果我们能够幸免于战争、

sentences.en: accidents and diseases we shall eventually 'die of old age', and that this happens at a rate which differs little from person to person,
sentences.zh: 事故和疾病，最终我们将“老死”，而且这个过程的速度人与人之间差异很小，

sentences.en: so that there are heavy odds in favour of our dying between the ages of 65 and 80.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们很可能在65到80岁之间去世。

sentences.en: Some of us will die sooner, a few will live longer -- on into a ninth or tenth decade.
sentences.zh: 我们中有些人会更早去世，少数人会活得更久——进入第九或第十个十年。

sentences.en: But the chances are against it,
sentences.zh: 但这种机会渺茫，

sentences.en: and there is a virtual limit on how long we can hope to remain alive, however lucky and robust we are.
sentences.zh: 而且我们能期望活多久，无论我们多么幸运和健壮，都有一个实际的限制。

sentences.en: Normal people tend to forget this process unless and until they are reminded of it.
sentences.zh: 除非被提醒，否则常人往往会忘记这个过程。

sentences.en: We are so familiar with the fact that man ages, that people have for years assumed that the process of losing vigour with time,
sentences.zh: 我们对人会衰老这一事实非常熟悉，以至于人们多年来一直认为，随着时间流逝而失去活力，

sentences.en: of becoming more likely to die the older we get, was something self-evident
sentences.zh: 年纪越大越可能死亡的过程，是理所当然的事情，

sentences.en: like the cooling of a hot kettle or the wearing-out of a pair of shoes.
sentences.zh: 就像热水壶变凉或鞋子磨损一样。

sentences.en: They have also assumed that all animals,
sentences.zh: 他们还假设所有动物，

sentences.en: and probably other organisms such as trees, or even the universe itself, must in the nature of things 'wear out'.
sentences.zh: 以及其他生物，如树木，甚至宇宙本身，按照事物的本性都必然会“耗尽”。

sentences.en: Most animals we commonly observe do in fact age as we do,
sentences.zh: 我们通常观察到的大多数动物，如果活得足够长，

sentences.en: if given the chance to live long enough;
sentences.zh: 确实会像我们一样衰老；

sentences.en: and mechanical systems like a wound watch, or the sun,
sentences.zh: 而像上弦的钟表或太阳这样的机械系统，

sentences.en: do in fact run out of energy in accordance with the second law of thermodynamics (whether the whole universe does so is a moot point at present).
sentences.zh: 确实会根据热力学第二定律耗尽能量（整个宇宙是否如此，目前尚无定论）。

sentences.en: But these are not analogous to what happens when man ages.
sentences.zh: 但这些与人类衰老时发生的情况并不相似。

sentences.en: A run-down watch is still a watch and can be rewound.
sentences.zh: 一只停走的表仍然是一只表，可以重新上弦。

sentences.en: An old watch, by contrast, becomes so worn and unreliable that it eventually is not worth mending.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，一只旧表会变得磨损不堪，不可靠，最终不值得修理。

sentences.en: But a watch could never repair itself--it does not consist of living parts, only of metal, which wears away by friction.
sentences.zh: 但是表永远无法自我修复——它不包含活体部分，只有金属，金属会因摩擦而磨损。

sentences.en: We could, at one time, repair ourselves--well enough, at least, to overcome all but the most instantly fatal illnesses and accidents.
sentences.zh: 我们曾经能够自我修复——至少足以克服除了最即刻致命的疾病和事故之外的所有情况。

sentences.en: Between twelve and eighty years we gradually lose this power;
sentences.zh: 在十二岁到八十岁之间，我们逐渐失去这种能力；

sentences.en: an illness which at 12 would knock us over, at 80 can knock us out, and into our grave.
sentences.zh: 一种在12岁时会让我们病倒的疾病，在80岁时可能就会让我们倒下，并送入坟墓。

sentences.en: If we could stay as vigorous as we are at twelve,
sentences.zh: 如果我们能像十二岁时那样充满活力，

sentences.en: it would take about 700 years for half of us to die, and another 700 for the survivors to be reduced by half again.
sentences.zh: 大约需要700年我们中一半的人才会去世，再过700年，幸存者数量才会再次减少一半。

grammar.title: however引导的让步状语从句
grammar.definition: however用来引导让步状语从句，表示“无论如何；不管多么”，相当于no matter how，用来引出无论在什么情况下主句的内容都成立
grammar.structure: however + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语，主句
grammar.usage: 用于强调无论某种情况达到什么程度，都不会影响主句的结果，从句需要用陈述语序

examples.en: However well we look after ourselves, we cannot stop the process of ageing.
examples.zh: 无论我们把自己照顾得多好，都无法阻止衰老的过程。

examples.en: However hard he tried, he could not solve the complicated math problem.
examples.zh: 无论他多么努力，都解不出这道复杂的数学题。

grammar.title: It作形式主语的名词性从句
grammar.definition: 当主语是较长的that从句时，为了避免句子头重脚轻，常用it作形式主语放在句首，真正的主语从句放在句末
grammar.structure: It + be + 名词/形容词 + that引导的主语从句
grammar.usage: 用来表达某个事实是怎样的，常见的结构有It is a fact that..., It is unpleasant that..., It is obvious that...等

examples.en: It is one of the most unpleasant discoveries which we all make that we must decline in this way as we age.
examples.zh: 我们所有人都会有的最令人不快的发现之一，就是我们随着年龄增长必然会这样衰退。

examples.en: It is a common belief that regular exercise is good for physical and mental health.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为规律锻炼对身心健康有益。

grammar.title: so...that...引导的结果状语从句
grammar.definition: so...that...结构用来引导结果状语从句，表示“如此……以至于……”，说明前面的情况导致的结果
grammar.structure: 主语 + 谓语 + so + 形容词/副词 + that + 结果从句
grammar.usage: so后面接形容词或副词，that后面接完整的句子表示结果，口语中that有时可以省略

examples.en: The loss of vigour will finally become so steep that we can live no longer.
examples.zh: 精力的衰退最终会变得非常急剧，以至于我们无法再活下去。

examples.en: The novel was so interesting that I stayed up all night reading it.
examples.zh: 这本小说太有趣了，以至于我熬了一整夜看完它。

patterns.pattern: This + 表示现象的名词 + with the passing of time is called + 术语名词.

original.en: This decline in vigour with the passing of time is called ageing.
original.zh: 这种随着时间流逝发生的精力衰退被称为衰老。

examples.en: This gradual rise in global temperature with the passing of time is called global warming.
examples.zh: 这种随着时间推移发生的全球气温逐渐上升被称为全球变暖。

examples.en: This slow loss of memory with the passing of time is called age-related amnesia.
examples.zh: 这种随着时间推移发生的记忆缓慢丧失被称为年龄相关性健忘。

patterns.pattern: We are so familiar with the fact that + 客观事实, that people have for years assumed that + 普遍看法.

original.en: We are so familiar with the fact that man ages, that people have for years assumed that the process of losing vigour with time was something self-evident.
original.zh: 我们对人会衰老这一事实如此熟悉，以至于多年来人们一直认为，精力随着时间流逝而衰退的过程是不言自明的。

examples.en: We are so familiar with the fact that the sun rises in the east, that people have for years assumed that this rule will never change.
examples.zh: 我们对太阳从东方升起这一事实如此熟悉，以至于多年来人们一直认为这个规律永远不会改变。

examples.en: We are so familiar with the fact that water flows downhill, that people have for years assumed that gravity is a natural force we can never resist.
examples.zh: 我们对水往低处流这一事实如此熟悉，以至于多年来人们一直认为重力是我们永远无法抗拒的自然力。

patterns.pattern: If we could stay as + 形容词 + as we are at + 年龄, it would take about + 时间段 + for + 事件发生.

original.en: If we could stay as vigorous as we are at twelve, it would take about 700 years for half of us to die.
original.zh: 如果我们能一直保持12岁时的活力，那么我们中有一半人死亡需要大约700年的时间。

examples.en: If we could stay as curious as we are at five, it would take a lifetime for us to run out of questions to ask about the world.
examples.zh: 如果我们能一直保持5岁时的好奇心，那么我们要花一辈子的时间才会问完对世界的所有问题。

examples.en: If we could stay as fast as we are at twenty, it would take only 10 seconds for us to finish the 100-meter race.
examples.zh: 如果我们能一直保持20岁时的速度，那么我们只需要10秒就能跑完100米。
